chunks: I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: "Game that was eaten by a group of people in ihram."
He عليه السلام said: "Upon each of them is one sheep, and upon the one who slaughtered it there is only one sheep."

key_terms.صَيْدٌ: game animal that has been hunted
key_terms.عَلَيْهِمْ: incumbent upon them as a legal obligation
key_terms.مُحْرِمُونَ: people in the state of ihram for hajj or ʿumrah

ai.seo_question: What is required of muhrims who eat hunted game while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning people in ihram who eat hunted game. It states that each person who ate from it owes a sheep, while the one who slaughtered the game owes only a single sheep, establishing individual liability in this case.
